question: Which code writes the near-map province name's point for a province positions.txt gives no text_position, with its exact arithmetic; whether the layout differs for such a province; checked against the maintainer's measurement that every such name stands about 1.9 map pixels south of the bounding-box centre.

addresses.name: CMap::ComputeProvinceGeometry
addresses.comment:
The per-province derived-geometry pass, called once at rva 0x8A739 inside CMap::LoadMapFiles - unconditionally, after the map cache branch rejoins at rva 0x8A6C6, and **immediately before CMap::LoadPositionsFile at rva 0x8A73F**, so everything it writes is a default that positions.txt then overwrites where it has a key. `ret 4` at rva 0x91CC3. Read whole 2026-11-12. For every province `i` below `[this+0x21FC]`, template `t = [this+0x2A60][i]`:

    t->centre_x (+0x2C) = t->bbox_x (+0x80) + t->bbox_width  (+0x88) / 2      ; cdq/sub/sar - integer, truncating
    t->centre_y (+0x30) = t->bbox_y (+0x84) + t->bbox_height (+0x8C) / 2      ; width and height count pixels, so min + (max - min + 1) / 2
    t->label (+0x5C/+0x60) = t->centre
    t->size_class (+0x24) = 1, 2, 3, 4 as bbox_width + bbox_height < 30, < 60, < 90, else
    every pixel pair of [+0x6C, +0x70) -= centre                               ; rva 0x9187F
    if (centre_x == 0 || centre_y == 0) centre = label = (1, 1)                ; rva 0x918A9
    t->position (+0x64/+0x68) = label;  t->northern_hemisphere (+0xA2) = position_y >= CMap height (+0x2A78) / 2
    t->city (+0x4C/+0x50)          = ((float)label_x, (float)label_y)
    t->text_position (+0x3C/+0x40) = ((float)label_x, (float)((double)(float)label_y - 2.0))   ; rva 0x91905..0x91926, the double 2.0 at VA 0x160A360

**So a province positions.txt gives no `text_position` has its name's point two map pixels SOUTH of its bounding-box centre** (y grows northward), exactly, for every text_scale; x is the centre's. The city and unit points get the plain centre. Then the building-type vectors: the `vector<CMapPoint>` at +0x258 and the `vector<float>` at +0x268 are resized to the building-type count (rva 0x919E5..0x91B66 - shrink through rva 0xACBD0 / grow through rva 0xAC830 and CMapPointFillDefaultN at rva 0x91A8F, and rva 0xC0700 for the floats; no-ops in practice, the constructor having sized both), and every building position is set to ((float)label_x, (float)label_y) and every nudge to 0.0f (rva 0x91BB3..0x91C8F, unrolled four to a pass with a remainder loop) - so a building positions.txt does not place stands on the centre, with no 2.0. The lazily made 0x30-byte object at the global VA 0x1A870D4 (rva 0x91938..0x919DA) only supplies the building-type count here.

CProvinceTemplate::Save (rva 0xAA300) compares text_position against the same (label_x, label_y - 2.0) to decide whether to write the key, which is the writing side's agreement with this default.
addresses.revises: Was 'copies [the centre] into ... the float pairs at +0x3C/+0x40 and +0x4C/+0x50' with 'Not read: rva 0x91B80 onward'. The +0x40 copy has 2.0 subtracted (rva 0x91917..0x91926), which is the whole answer to FINDINGS-farmap.md B.7.1's open 'which step writes the centre into +0x3C/+0x40'; the (0,0) guard and the building-position fill are added; the function is now read to its ret.
addresses.evidence: Decoded from the entry 0x4917A0 to the ret 4 at 0x491CC3 with scripts/disasm.py and image.decode. The subtraction: `cvtps2pd xmm1,xmm1; subsd xmm1,[0x160a360]; cvtpd2ps; movss [esi+0x40],xmm1` at VA 0x491917..0x491926, after a plain store of the same value at 0x491912; image.read(0x160A360, 8) is the IEEE double 2.0. The source register edi = esi+0x5C (lea at 0x4917F8). Every store in 0x491926..0x491CC6 listed: none is to the template's +0x3C/+0x40/+0x5C/+0x60 (the [ecx+edx+0x3C] at 0x491C3C is the fourth CMapPoint's y in the +0x258 array, ebx = esi+0x258 at 0x4919F1). Positive control on the arithmetic: for Bautzen 2265, Lauban 2323, Sagar 2266, Neusalz 2211, Glogau 2268, Varnsdorf 2380 and Altenberg 2379 (TFH, no text_position) the rule puts the name exactly 2.0 map pixels south of the bounding-box centre the rewrite uses, against the maintainer's measured ~1.9. Would be wrong if something after the geometry pass and before ProvinceTexts_Create rewrote +0x40 for a province with no text_position: a scan of float stores to [reg+0x3C]/[reg+0x40] over VA 0x480000-0x4B0000 (int3-chunked, capstone resumed past stops) finds only the constructor (0x4A92F8/FD), this pass, the text_position handler (0x48FE70/75), CProvinceTemplate::Save (0x4AA76F/93) and two other classes (CTerrainGraphical 0x4880EB, CTree 0x48C441).

addresses.name: CProvinceTemplate::Save
addresses.comment:
CProvinceTemplate **slot 1**, i.e. it overrides `Save` itself rather than `SaveContents` - slot 2 on this class is the generic `ret 4` stub at rva 0x20CD50 - so this body writes the braces and the whole key list of one positions.txt province block. `this` in ECX (rva 0xAA324), writer at [ebp+8], `ret 4` at rva 0xAB2D1 with a bare `ret` at rva 0xAB308 after it (trap 3 territory, not resolved here).

**What was established:** it is the only thing besides the loaders that walks the two per-building vectors whole. It takes the element count as `([this+0x25C] - [this+0x258])` at rva 0xAAA03 and indexes +0x258 at four more places, and it does the same for +0x268/+0x26C at rva 0xAAC4B - immediately before the one reference in the image to the `'building_nudge'` literal at VA 0x15C0638 (rva 0xAAC9B). That pins +0x268 as the `building_nudge` block's vector from the writing side as well as the reading side.

**Which keys it writes, read 2026-11-12 (rva 0xAA326..0xAA3FE):** each point only where it differs from the default CMap::ComputeProvinceGeometry gave it -

    write unit          where (label_x, label_y) (+0x5C/+0x60) != (position_x, position_y) (+0x64/+0x68)
    write city          where (label_x, label_y) != ((int)city_x, (int)city_y)     ; cvttss2si of +0x4C/+0x50
    write text_position where text_position (+0x3C, +0x40) != ((float)label_x, (float)((double)(float)label_y - 2.0))   ; ucomisd, the double 2.0 at VA 0x160A360
    write text_rotation where +0x54 != 0.0f;  text_scale where +0x58 != 1.0f

- the writing side's statement of the same defaults, **the 2.0 below the centre included**. Before writing text_position it rounds both halves **in the template itself** through RoundToOneDecimal (rva 0xA91F0) and stores them back (rva 0xAA76F, 0xAA793), then writes token 0x3D2 (`text_position`) at rva 0xAA798. Who calls it (the hidden map editor's save, *inferred*) was not read.

**Not read:** the rest, most of 0xFD0 bytes.
addresses.revises: Comment only: adds which keys it writes and the defaults it compares against - the second witness for the text_position fallback (centre less 2.0 in y) - and the in-place rounding through rva 0xA91F0.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x4AA300..0x4AA7A9 with scripts/disasm.py. At 0x4AA326..0x4AA350: xmm1 = (float)[edi+0x60] widened, minus the qword at 0x160A360 (2.0), narrowed; xmm0 = (float)[edi+0x5C]. At 0x4AA37F..0x4AA3C6 +0x3C is compared with xmm0 and +0x40 with xmm1 (ucomisd, lahf, test ah 0x44, jp = unequal), and [esp+0x1E] = not both equal; [esp+0x1E] gates the block at 0x4AA74F..0x4AA798 that rounds and writes token 0x3D2. +0x54 against [0x15BED10] (0.0f) and +0x58 against [0x171DBAC] (1.0f) set [esp+0x1D]/[esp+0x1C]. Would be wrong if the 0x3D2 write were reached on another path not gated by [esp+0x1E]; only the one path was read.

addresses.name: RoundToOneDecimal
addresses.comment: floor(x * 10.0 + 0.5) / 10.0, i.e. x rounded half up to one decimal place. The 10 is 10^1 built by two inlined integer-power loops over the double 10.0 at VA 0x160A340 from 1.0 (VA 0x160A248), so the decimal count was a compile-time 1; the +0.5 is the double at VA 0x160A308; the floor is the SSE2 add-and-subtract-2^52 idiom with a sign mask and a correction step (VA 0x4A924F..0x4A929D). The double comes back in XMM0, which every caller reads with cvtsd2ss xmm0,xmm0. Bare `ret` at rva 0xA92A6; the caller pops its 8 bytes (`add esp, 8` at rva 0xAA786). Six callers, all in CProvinceTemplate::Save (rvas 0xAA766, 0xAA781, 0xAA887, 0xAA8A2, 0xAAB21, 0xAAB4B) - the text_position pair and, *likely*, two more point pairs. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x4A91F0..0x4A92A6 with image.decode; image.read gives 10.0 at 0x160A340, 1.0 at 0x160A248, 0.5 at 0x160A308. findRefs.py --callers 0x4A91F0 returns the six call sites, all between 0x4AA300 and the end of Save. Would be wrong if the add-subtract idiom rounds to nearest rather than flooring: the cmpnlesd/andpd/subsd correction at 0x4A9290..0x4A929D subtracts 1.0 where the rounded value exceeded the input, which is floor; the two constants at 0x160A450/0x160A458 (sign mask, 2^52) were not read.

struct_fields.name: text_position_x
struct_fields.comment: positions.txt's `text_position` x, as a float, written at 0x48FE70. Paris reads 2786.300048828125 against the file's x=2786.300049. On a sea zone the same handler also truncates this pair into +0x64/+0x68; on a land province it does not. **Where the province has no `text_position` it is the bounding-box centre x as a float** (label_x, +0x5C), written by CMap::ComputeProvinceGeometry at rva 0x91905 before positions.txt is read. The constructor's 0.0 (rva 0xA92F8) never survives. Read by ProvinceTexts_Create (rva 0x456871) as the near-map name's point. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincenamepoint.md.
struct_fields.revises: Comment only: adds the default for a province without text_position, and the reader.
struct_fields.evidence: movd xmm1,[edi]; cvtdq2ps; movss [esi+0x3C],xmm1 at VA 0x4918FE..0x491905, edi = esi+0x5C. CProvinceTemplate::Save compares +0x3C with (float)label_x (VA 0x4AA330/0x4AA392). ProvinceTexts_Create reads movss xmm0,[eax+0x3C] at VA 0x856871. Wrong if another store to the template's +0x3C ran between the geometry pass and ProvinceTexts_Create - the store scan over VA 0x480000-0x4B0000 found none.

struct_fields.name: text_position_y
struct_fields.comment: The y beside +0x3C, written at 0x48FE75. Paris reads 1657.5 against the file's y=1657.500000. **Where the province has no `text_position` it is the bounding-box centre y less 2.0** - (float)((double)(float)label_y - 2.0), the double at VA 0x160A360 - written by CMap::ComputeProvinceGeometry at rva 0x91926 before positions.txt is read: so such a province's near-map name stands two map pixels south of its centre (y grows northward). Hardcoded; nothing in a file moves it. CProvinceTemplate::Save treats the same value as the default it does not write. Read by ProvinceTexts_Create (rva 0x456876). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincenamepoint.md.
struct_fields.revises: Comment only: adds the default - the centre less 2.0 - for a province without text_position, and the reader.
struct_fields.evidence: VA 0x49190A..0x491926: movd [edi+4]; cvtdq2ps; movss [esi+0x40]; cvtps2pd; subsd [0x160A360]; cvtpd2ps; movss [esi+0x40]. image.read(0x160A360,8) = 2.0. Save at VA 0x4AA326..0x4AA3A8 compares +0x40 with the same expression. Against TFH's provinces.bmp the rule puts seven text_position-less Silesian/Saxon provinces exactly 2.0 south of the rewrite's centre; the maintainer measured ~1.9. Wrong if a later store rewrote +0x40 - none found by the scan named on +0x3C.

struct_fields.name: label_x
struct_fields.comment: A second copy of the bounding-box centre, x half, initialised at 0x91822 from +0x2C. The only later change in CMap::ComputeProvinceGeometry is the guard at rva 0x918A9: where centre_x or centre_y is 0, centre and label both become (1, 1). It is then the source of every point's default: position (+0x64/+0x68), city (+0x4C/+0x50), text_position (+0x3C/+0x40, less 2.0 in y) and each building position, and CProvinceTemplate::Save compares those points with it to decide what to write. A map pixel coordinate. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincenamepoint.md.
struct_fields.revises: Comment only: 'the code after it in 0x917A0 goes on to refine this pair' was wrong - the function, now read to its ret, changes it only by the (0,0) -> (1,1) guard; and its role as the default of every point is added.
struct_fields.evidence: Every store in 0x917A0..0x91CC3 listed: [edi] (= +0x5C) is written at VA 0x491822 and, under the guard, 0x4918B6; nothing else. Readers [edi]/[edi+4] at 0x4918BE, 0x4918E5..0x49190F and 0x491BB3..0x491C34 copy it into the other points. Wrong if a later function refines +0x5C before the names are made - not searched beyond this function, but the names read +0x3C/+0x40, which the label was copied into before any such refinement could matter.

slots_noted: CProvinceTemplate::Save is already recorded at slot 1; RoundToOneDecimal is in no virtual table (called directly six times).
